_comment: Deterministic lookup: sector/keyword -> mandatory certification scheme. Expand this table from BIS's Mandatory Certification list and CRS Order before the final demo. Keys are matched case-insensitively as substrings against sector + title + query.

rules.scheme: BIS Product Certification (ISI Mark) — mandatory under Electrical/Electronic Goods Order
steps: Apply via BIS Manak Online portal (manakonline.bis.gov.in)
Sample testing at a BIS-recognised laboratory for the specific IS
Factory inspection by BIS officer
Grant of licence to use Standard Mark (ISI mark)

rules.scheme: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) under BIS (Electronics & IT Goods) Order
rules.authority: Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) — CRS Division
steps: Product testing at a BIS-recognised lab against the applicable IS
Apply for registration on BIS CRS portal
Self-declaration of conformity + registration number display on product

rules.authority: Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) — Hallmarking Scheme
steps: Get BIS Hallmarking registration as a jeweller
Get articles hallmarked at a BIS-recognised Assaying & Hallmarking Centre (AHC)
Verify HUID (Hallmark Unique ID) at point of sale

rules.scheme: BIS Product Certification (ISI Mark) — mandatory for cement and steel under respective Quality Control Orders
steps: Apply via BIS Manak Online portal
Sample testing at BIS-recognised laboratory
Factory inspection
Grant of ISI mark licence

rules.scheme: FSSAI Licence/Registration (in addition to any applicable BIS product standard)
rules.authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
steps: Determine FBO category (petty/state/central) based on turnover
Apply on FoSCoS portal (foscos.fssai.gov.in)
Comply with applicable food safety standard testing

rules.scheme: CDSCO Medical Device Registration (in addition to applicable BIS/ISO standard)
steps: Classify device (Class A/B/C/D) per Medical Device Rules
Apply via SUGAM portal (cdscomdonline.gov.in)
Comply with applicable quality/testing standard

default.scheme: No mandatory scheme identified in this lookup table for the given product — verify manually via BIS 'Mandatory Certification' list at bis.gov.in.
